cs.t: Huh. I’m not sure about PowerSpec but they do have an in-house laptop and tablet brand: “WinBook”. I’ve owned 2 and had challenges with both. Most recently: - Touchscreen driver wouldn’t shut off when lid closed - Inadequate cooling leading to overheating - The worst touchpad I’ve ever had the displeasure to use I really do love MicroCenter, I built a gaming PC there myself, but I recommend using the known brands when it comes to systems.
